## What lives here
The HTTP API: one router per resource. Thin handlers over the services and domain packages.

## Conventions
Prefixed with `API_PREFIX` (`/api`). Every route needs an access rule in `auth/permissions.py`.

## Entry points
Included by `main.py`.
